## About Me

I’m The Code Writer — a developer and data practitioner sharing practical lessons on programming, technology, career transitions, and life beyond the code.

My day-to-day work focuses on data engineering and machine learning solutions, with a strong interest in building reliable, production-ready systems.

## What You'll Find Here

Content on this blog spans:

- **Python & data science tutorials** — from beginner fundamentals to production patterns
- **Quarto & reproducible publishing** — practical guides on authoring data-driven content
- **Career transitions** — honest reflections on navigating the tech industry and life beyond the code
- **Tool reviews** — hands-on coverage of development and data tooling

Planned series include *Data Science Workflows*, *Quarto Deep Dives*, and *Career Transitions* — subscribe to the [RSS feed](https://lifeaftercoding.net/index.xml) for updates.

## Research Focus

My research direction centers on **interpretable and explainable forecasting models**:

- transparent forecasting workflows that make predictions easier to trust
- explainability techniques for time-series use cases (feature attribution and model reasoning)
- better communication between advanced ML models and business decision-makers

For publications and research updates, visit my [Google Scholar profile](https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=hrEn-wIAAAAJ).
